# zerops_organization (Data Source)

Reads an organization membership by organization ID.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "zerops_organization" "example" {
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `id` (String) Organization ID; defaults to the provider organization.

### Read-Only

- `name` (String) Organization account name.
- `role` (String) Membership role.
